title: OpenAI banned China-origin accounts using AI for influence activity
summary: OpenAI banned accounts using AI to generate posts criticizing a Taiwanese social media influencer and related US topics, attributed to a China-origin operation dubbed 'Sneer Review'.
why_included: This details AI's use in targeted influence campaigns and character assassination, with OpenAI taking action against the perpetrators.

title: OpenAI banned Cambodian accounts using AI for task scams
summary: OpenAI banned accounts likely originating in Cambodia that used AI to support scam workflows targeting people in the UK, known as Operation 'Wrong Number'.
why_included: This points to the use of AI in cross-border scams and OpenAI's efforts to shut down such operations.

title: OpenAI banned Iran-linked operation using AI for influence activity
summary: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the likely Iran-linked STORM-2035 operation using AI to create influence content about US, UK, Irish, and Venezuelan politics.
why_included: This illustrates AI's role in geopolitical influence campaigns originating from Iran and OpenAI's detection of these activities.

title: OpenAI banned China-origin accounts using AI for US polarization
summary: OpenAI banned China-origin accounts using AI to generate US political content and research people, movements, and online communities, dubbed Operation 'Uncle Spam'.

title: OpenAI banned accounts using AI for Philippine political comments
summary: OpenAI banned accounts using AI to generate comments about Philippine politics and public officials across social platforms, known as Operation 'High Five'.

title: OpenAI banned Russian-origin accounts using AI for German influence

title: OpenAI banned China-linked cyber operations using AI

title: OpenAI banned accounts using AI for social engineering and influence
